'''Nixor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], coreward of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Nixor (species)|Nixor]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==History==
During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] came from [[Attahox/Legends|Attahox]] and [[Battle of the Nixor system|conquered]] the planet, from which they moved to [[Daalang/Legends|Daalang]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the early years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Nixor was known as a place for an independent starship captain to hide from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. However, the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] on Nixor were poorly maintained, primarily because the Nixor people wanted nothing to do with either the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] or Empire and their regulations. Thus, although it was a good place to hide, Nixor offered nothing in the way of amenities or [[Starship/Legends|starship]] services.<ref name="DW" />
